root_cause: Toxiproxy injects 3000ms latency (+500ms jitter) on the network path from order-service to payment-service. Requests to POST /orders time out waiting for payment confirmation.
expected_fix: Remove the Toxiproxy latency toxic via DELETE http://localhost:8474/proxies/payment-proxy/toxics/payment-latency. In production: investigate network congestion, firewall rules, or upstream service degradation
